title: Work IQ: how agents reach Microsoft 365 and business data, and what an admin can switch off
summary: Hold: the consent-revocation path omits the permission-selection step, and consent automation is incorrectly reported as undocumented. The environment control also conflates enabling Work IQ features with allowing data participation, while the oversharing explanation overlooks documented policy restrictions.

claims.claim: Work IQ is Microsoft's workplace intelligence layer for agents and applications to reason over and act on organisational data.
claims.quote: Work IQ is a workplace intelligence layer that enables agents to access and reason over organizational and business data, context, and tools.

claims.where: summary; What it is; Why it matters
claims.claim: Every Work IQ request runs in a specific signed-in user's context and cannot exceed that user's access.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.where: What it is: opening paragraph and Context row
claims.claim: Work IQ assembles grounded context internally so agents need not build their own retrieval pipelines.
claims.quote: Work IQ assembles and grounds context internally across organizational and business data to provide agent-ready inputs, so agents don't need to stitch together raw signals or manage retrieval pipelines.

claims.claim: Work IQ exposes A2A, Model Context Protocol and REST interfaces.
claims.quote: Work IQ provides multiple protocols to interact with agents - Agent-to-Agent (A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and REST

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Work IQ in terms of Chat, Context, Tools and Workspaces.
claims.quote: Combining chat, context, tools, and workspaces, Work IQ supports high-volume, multistep interactions and works across frameworks and runtimes through standard protocols.

claims.claim: Chat provides conversational responses over A2A and REST.
claims.quote: Chat is optimized for conversational intelligence. Work IQ supports A2A for agent-to-agent collaboration and REST for web application interactions

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP server exposes ten generic tools.
claims.quote: The Work IQ MCP collapses hundreds of operations into just 10 generic tools
claims.fix: Remove the fixed count or report the documentation discrepancy: the cited overview says ten, but https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/mcp/overview lists seven entity tools, three Copilot tools and two schema tools. Use the live tools/list result for availability.
